cards.title: Dermalogica Pro-Collagen Banking Serum is Proven
cards.body: 100% of its users had a visible change held to week 8, against 46% of non-users with the same goals (n=32).

cards.title: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Ampoule Foam works best on oily skin
cards.body: 91% of its users with oily skin had a visible change (n=11), against 28% of non-users with oily skin.

cards.title: People stop Dr. Jart+ Cicapair Foam Cleanser
cards.body: Only 56% of its users were still using it at week 8 (n=34).

cards.title: People don't feel Melano Signal Essence Jumbo working yet
cards.body: 60% of users asked had a visible change but didn't say it was working (self-reported, n=58). Changes typically show around week 6: say so on pack.

cards.title: Dark spots demand is rising
cards.body: 31% of people with a reading in November had this goal, up from 30% in October (n=30991).

cards.title: Under-eye: the biggest unmet need
cards.body: 84% of people with this goal had no visible change by week 8 (n=4143).

Minimalist.title: Minimalist leads the market for pores and texture
Minimalist.body: 51% of Minimalist users with this goal had a visible change held to week 8 (n=225), market 38%.

Minimalist.title: Minimalist trails the market for redness
Minimalist.body: 29% of Minimalist users with this goal had a visible change held to week 8 (n=24), market 32%.

Minimalist.title: Minimalist is winning switchers
Minimalist.body: 43 more people switched to Minimalist than away from it, within the same category.

Minimalist.title: People don't feel Tranexamic 03% for PIE, PIH & Scars - Face Serum with Mandelic Acid 3% for All Skin Type working yet
Minimalist.body: 57% of users asked had a visible change but didn't say it was working (self-reported, n=23). Changes typically show around week 7: say so on pack.

Minimalist.title: Tranexamic 03% for PIE, PIH & Scars - Face Serum with Mandelic Acid 3% for All Skin Type: Proven
Minimalist.body: 67% of its users had a visible change held to week 8 (n=46), non-users with the same goals 27%.

Minimalist.title: 9 Minimalist products can be promoted
Minimalist.body: Proven products can be shown to Willow users with a matching goal.
